real_pack_ladder.triage_root_cause: RESOLVED (session 9, cells dsv5m7h-ladder0/7b/7c): the 26 divergences are NOT semantic. Bit-level: oracle kv_normed[l8][112]=0x3e29 vs anchor 0x3e28 - one bf16 ulp from f32 accumulation order (numpy pairwise vs C sequential inside the 32-wide k-block); 0x3e28 is the EXACT fp8 tie 1.3125x2^-3, so RNE-even gives dequant 0.15625 vs 0.171875 (one code step, 9%), and the amplified element crosses the attention softmax into the cascade. fp8-midpoint tie density measured ~2.75% of kv quant inputs at BOTH l2 and l8 (1882/1848 of 67584) - exposure is layer-uniform; which ties fire is 1-ulp luck. l2 router flips sit at oracle key gaps 0.0003-0.0033 (top-6 boundary); l8 flips at 0.0015-0.0033 under stream contamination
real_pack_ladder.instrument_noise_model: session 9 recalibration, all measured: kv_row + attn_out_rope_inv carry dequant-boundary tolerances (rel 3e-2 x tol_amp, drift-exempt); wo_b_out drift-exempt at 2e-2 x tol_amp (measured <= 0.19 of limit everywhere); ffn-side tagged pieces carry a 25x drift amplifier (was 5x; measured cascade need up to 19x), attn-side 1x at p0 / 25x at p1+; router_indices accepts a slot flip when the two experts' own selection keys differ below ROUTER_TIE_FLOOR 0.03; stream emission restructured - end-to-end stream pieces are layer 0 only (chaos crossings are layer-dependent on the synthetic fixture: l2/l8 pos 46, l14 pos 40, l20 pos 4, l38 pos 7) and the router/routed/moe group is tagged at p0 only (l20 p4 had an admitted key-gap-0.00018 swap whose routed composition delta 0.14 has no honest per-element tolerance)
